mods.description: Spotify overlay for Minecraft with playlist management, search and a Simple Voice Chat listening party.

releases.notes:
Version 1.2.1 makes the lyrics animations smoother: they are drawn every frame now instead of 20 times a second. An account that the owner of the app has not added under User Management used to fail silently after the login; the mod now says why. Version 1.2 added the choice of animation and font from lists with a live preview and a Help button beside the client ID field. One jar for every Minecraft version from 1.21 to 1.21.11.

## Which file

| File | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `SpotifyControl_1.2.1_1.21.x_BETA.jar` | The mod. Connects to your own Spotify account. |
| `SpotifyControl_1.2.1_1.21.x_DEMO.jar` | Screenshots only. Shows an invented library and never connects to Spotify. |

Install one of them, not both: they carry the same mod id, and Fabric will refuse to load two copies.

## Install

1. Fabric Loader 0.16 or higher, and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for your Minecraft version.
2. Drop `SpotifyControl_1.2.1_1.21.x_BETA.jar` into `mods/`.
3. In game press Ctrl + M, open Settings and paste the client ID of a Spotify app you created at [developer.spotify.com/dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard), with `http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback` as the redirect URI.

For listening parties the same jar has to be installed on the client and on the server. Broadcast mode also needs Simple Voice Chat 2.5 or higher on both sides.

## What it does

- Full overlay in the Spotify colour theme: library, search, playlist detail views and a player bar
- OAuth 2.0 login with PKCE, no client secret, tokens stored locally and refreshed automatically
- Playback control, queue, device transfer, and playlist management including reordering
- Album art and icons rasterized at screen resolution, so nothing is blocky at any GUI scale
- Six accent palettes, applied across the whole interface including the logo
- Now playing HUD, seven languages, Mod Menu integration
- Lyrics in the world: the synced lyrics of the playing song appear word by word as 3D text in front of you and fade out when their line ends. Size, distance, tilt, font, animation and the fade in and out are adjustable, and a lyrics button next to the queue button switches them on and off
- A lyrics mark in every track list shows which songs have synced lyrics
- Listening parties in two modes: SYNC keeps every member's own Spotify player on the same track and position, BROADCAST streams the host's desktop audio through Simple Voice Chat
- On Windows, broadcast captures the speakers directly over WASAPI loopback. No Stereo Mix, no virtual cable and no microphone involved

The lyrics come from [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net), because the Spotify Web API offers none. Only the track title and the first artist are sent there, and nothing once Lyrics in the world is switched off.

Spotify only lets Premium accounts create the app that provides the client ID, and playback control needs Premium on the logged in account. A friend can log in through your app if you add their Spotify account under User Management in your app's settings on the dashboard.

Documentation is in the [wiki](https://github.com/EmilDeuOfficial/SpotifyControl/wiki). If voices or game sound end up in a broadcast, read [Streaming only Spotify](https://github.com/EmilDeuOfficial/SpotifyControl/wiki/Streaming-Only-Spotify).

Spotify is a trademark of Spotify AB, which is not affiliated with this project.

The bundled fonts (Pacifico, Lobster, Bangers, Press Start 2P, Orbitron, Creepster and Permanent Marker) come unmodified from the Google Fonts repository under the SIL Open Font License and the Apache License. Their license texts are inside the jar.

releases.notes:
Version 1.2 adds 8 fonts (15 bundled in all) and 9 animations (17 in all), all chosen from lists with a live preview in the settings. Every font is now sized to the height of Minecraft's capitals and shares its baseline, which fixes Press Start 2P being too large and off centre. One jar for every Minecraft version from 1.21 to 1.21.11.

Their license texts are inside the jar.
